$schema: Schema reference for EMPI module — detailed column metadata, indexes, constraints, and Citus distribution notes

patients.description: Golden record — canonical patient identity. Central table that all other modules reference via patient_id.

id.description: Internal patient identifier. Referenced by all clinical modules.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key. Every query must include this.

uhid.description: Human-facing patient ID. Format: YYMMDDTTTTTXXXXXXX (date + 5-digit tenant numeric code + 7-digit daily sequence). Generated at registration, immutable.

abha_number.description: 14-digit ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number. Presence implies KYC verification. Null for patients without ABHA. One per patient.

first_name.description: Given name. Required for all registrations.

last_name.description: Family/surname. Nullable because some Indian names have no surname.

full_name.description: Computed concatenation of first + middle + last. Stored for search performance and ABDM lookups. Updated on any name part change.

father_name.description: Father's name — required by Indian government registration forms (NABH, ABDM).

date_of_birth.description: Full date of birth when known. Nullable because rural patients often don't know exact DOB.

year_of_birth.description: Year-only fallback when exact DOB is unknown. Used with age fields for dedup.

age_years.description: Age in years at time of registration. Stored for dedup blocking (age ±2 years rule) when DOB is unknown.

age_months.description: Months component of age. Relevant for pediatric patients.

age_days.description: Days component of age. Relevant for neonates.

gender.description: Biological sex / administrative gender. Dedup blocking key.

phone_number.description: Primary contact phone number. Dedup blocking key. Format: 10-digit Indian mobile or with country code.

caste.description: Caste category (General, OBC, SC, ST). Required for government hospital reporting.

emergency_contact_relationship.description: Relationship of emergency contact to patient (spouse, parent, sibling, etc.).

status.description: Patient lifecycle status. Transitions: active → inactive (discharged/moved), active → deceased, inactive → active (returned).

merged_into_id.description: If this record was merged into another patient, points to the surviving record's id. Non-null = this is a 'dead' record. Queries should filter WHERE merged_into_id IS NULL for active patients.

registered_by.description: User ID of the person who originally registered this patient. May differ from created_by in import scenarios.

updated_by.description: User who last modified this row.

indexes.name: uq_patients_tenant_uhid
indexes.description: UHID is unique within a tenant.

indexes.name: uq_patients_tenant_abha
indexes.description: ABHA number is unique within a tenant (partial — only non-null values).

indexes.name: idx_patients_phone
indexes.description: Dedup blocking key — fast lookup by phone within tenant.

indexes.name: idx_patients_fullname_trgm
indexes.description: Trigram index for fuzzy name search. Requires pg_trgm extension.

patient_source_records.description: Provenance tracking — each row represents one system/encounter's contribution to a patient's data. Enables non-destructive merge via demographics arbitration.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

patient_id.description: FK to patients.id — which golden record this source contributes to.

source_system.description: Origin system or workflow that contributed this data. Values: 'opd_registration', 'abdm_kyc', 'legacy_import', 'admin_edit', 'self_service'.

source_reference.description: External reference for traceability — encounter ID, import batch ID, ABDM transaction ID, etc.

demographics_snapshot.description: Full demographics as received from this source. Only includes fields the source actually provided. Used for merge arbitration and audit.

contributed_at.description: When this source data was recorded.

contributed_by.description: User who contributed this data (null for system imports).

indexes.name: idx_source_records_patient
indexes.description: Look up all source records for a patient.

patient_identifiers.description: Cross-reference table for N-per-patient identifiers. Stores ABHA addresses, PHR addresses, legacy MRNs, and any future external system identifiers.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

patient_id.description: FK to patients.id — which patient this identifier belongs to.

identifier_type.description: Type discriminator. Extensible via CHECK constraint update.

source_record_id.description: Optional FK to patient_source_records.id — provenance of who told us this identifier.

is_active.description: Soft-disable without deletion. Inactive identifiers are not used for matching but retained for audit.

created_at.description: When this identifier was linked to the patient.

indexes.name: uq_identifiers_type_value
indexes.description: No duplicate identifiers within a tenant. E.g., one ABHA address cannot belong to two patients.

indexes.name: idx_identifiers_patient
indexes.description: Look up all identifiers for a patient.

patient_addresses.description: Normalized patient addresses with type discriminator. Separate table because addresses are multi-field structs.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

street.description: Street name, house number, locality, area.

updated_by.description: User who last modified this address.

indexes.name: idx_addresses_patient
indexes.description: Look up all addresses for a patient.

sequence_counters.description: Tenant-scoped UHID sequence generation. Atomic increment within transaction. Key resets daily (format: uhid_YYMMDD).

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

sequence_name.description: Counter key. Format: 'uhid_YYMMDD'. New key per day per tenant.

current_value.description: Monotonically increasing counter. Incremented via UPDATE ... SET current_value = current_value + 1 RETURNING current_value.

match_candidates.description: Future: batch/async dedup results queued for human review. Table created at MVP, logic implemented later when batch dedup is needed.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

patient_a_id.description: First patient in the potential match pair. FK to patients.id.

patient_b_id.description: Second patient in the potential match pair. FK to patients.id.

match_score.description: Confidence score from 0.0000 (unlikely match) to 1.0000 (certain match).

match_algorithm.description: Algorithm version that produced this match (e.g., 'abdm_rules_v1', 'fellegi_sunter_v1'). For reproducibility.

blocking_keys_matched.description: Which blocking keys matched between the pair: ['phone', 'name_phonetic', 'gender', 'age_range'].

status.description: Resolution status. Transitions: pending → confirmed_match → merged, or pending → confirmed_distinct.

reviewed_by.description: Staff member who resolved this match candidate.

created_at.description: When this potential match was detected by the algorithm.

indexes.name: idx_match_candidates_pending
indexes.description: Fast lookup of unresolved match candidates for the review queue.

merge_history.description: Audit trail for patient merge and unmerge operations. Non-destructive — captures full pre-merge state for reversal.

iq_tenant_id.description: Tenant isolation and Citus distribution key.

surviving_patient_id.description: The patient record that remains active after merge. FK to patients.id.

merged_patient_id.description: The patient record that was absorbed. Its merged_into_id now points to surviving_patient_id. FK to patients.id.

merge_reason.description: Free-text reason for the merge (e.g., 'Same patient registered twice with different phone').

pre_merge_snapshot.description: Complete state of both patient records before merge. Enables full reversal.

merged_by.description: User who performed the merge operation.

unmerged_at.description: If non-null, this merge has been reversed. The merged_patient_id record was restored.

indexes.name: idx_merge_history_surviving
indexes.description: Look up all merges into a given patient.

indexes.name: idx_merge_history_merged
indexes.description: Look up merge history for a retired patient record.

patient.created.description: Published when a new patient is registered. Rich payload for downstream projections.

patient.updated.description: Published when patient demographics are modified.

patient.merged.description: Published when two patient records are merged. Consumers must update their projections to reference surviving_patient_id.

patient.status-changed.description: Published when patient status transitions (active, inactive, deceased).

patient.identifier-linked.description: Published when a new identifier is linked to a patient (ABHA address, legacy MRN, etc.).
